immutable_rules: Agents never receive seed phrases, private keys or unrestricted signing credentials.
No wash trading, fake volume, coordinated pumping, hidden developer wallets or guaranteed-return claims.
Ordinary buying or selling is never treated as wrongdoing by itself.
Automated wallet discovery creates review signals, not accusations.
Wallet restrictions require corroborating documented evidence, high confidence, low false-positive risk and an appeal path.
Social and intelligence agents cannot execute treasury transactions.
Evolution cannot alter immutable security rules.
